evals.name: owned-ask-local-correction
evals.prompt: Internal EOD. Roger's notes say: Good progress today. Morgan already owns the discussion with the client about Monday release timing. I have no new decision to ask for. The first draft nevertheless ends with an ask to Morgan. Roger comments: Morgan is already handling this, no need to send it again. Return JSON with closing, edit, review_scope, and what you would report back. Do not execute tools beyond reading the skill and references.
assertions: Does not add or repeat an ask to Morgan
Removes the duplicate ask without inventing a release decision
Uses a local correction check and the EOD checker rather than rerunning both reviewers

evals.name: material-import-contradiction
evals.prompt: Client EOD. Roger says: I promised the archive import today, but it is blocked by the open three-tier support PR 84. Saved authoritative evidence says PR 71 already merged three-tier archive support yesterday; open PR 84 only stores subscription metadata and leaves access unchanged. There is no newer clarification from Roger. Return JSON with next_action, question_if_any, draft_ready, and proposed_public_wording_if_any. Do not execute services; read only the skill and relevant references.
assertions: Asks one focused question about the actual dependency or choice to wait
Pauses final drafting or rendering until clarification
Does not preserve the disputed causal link by rephrasing it as a temporal hold

evals.name: environment-specific-availability
evals.prompt: Client EOD. A feature PR merged at revision aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa. Roger has not said it deployed. The latest five GitHub workflow runs are green review-bot and documentation jobs. The intended client environment is staging. Return JSON with availability_claim, next_evidence_check, evidence_to_save, and whether workflow success verifies runtime behavior. Read the skill and relevant references, but do not call GitHub or other services.
assertions: Does not claim the feature is available from merge or unrelated green jobs
Checks staging and the expected release revision, using deployment records or a targeted deployment workflow
Separates deployment reports from runtime verification
